name: Flashing Strike (Combat)
body:
Your magic attacks sometimes create a flash of bright light.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit with an attack that deals magic damage (such as attacks with magic weapons or spells), your target is also dazzled for a number of rounds equal to half the damage dealt by your critical hit.
